fields.description: Joël Falmet Les Parcelles is a French Brut cuvée in a dark glass bottle, dressed in a textured white label with black typography and the house's signature calligraphic mark. The producer's name, Joël Falmet, is printed on the neck foil.
fields.name: Joël Falmet Les Parcelles

fields.description: Joël Falmet Millésime 2007 is a vintage-dated Champagne dressed in a dark graphite label with gold lettering and gold foil on the neck. The harvest year, 2007, is stated on the front label.
fields.name: Joël Falmet Millésime 2007

fields.description: Joël Falmet Nacarat is a rosé Champagne with a deep copper-salmon hue, in a clear glass bottle with rose-copper foil and a light label. The label states the producer Joël Falmet, the village of Rouvres-les-Vignes, and the cuvée name Nacarat.
fields.name: Joël Falmet Nacarat Rosé

fields.description: Joël Falmet L'Empreinte is an Extra Brut Champagne in a dark glass bottle. The design is rendered in deep graphite with a gold house mark and restrained, premium typography.
fields.name: Joël Falmet L'Empreinte

fields.description: Champagne Joël Falmet Plénitude des Sens Réserve is dressed in a deep burgundy-raspberry label with gold typography and the house monogram. The name translates to 'Fullness of the Senses.'
fields.name: Joël Falmet Plénitude des Sens Réserve

fields.description: Joël Falmet Éclat Blanc has a light label on a dark glass bottle, neck foil, and restrained gold typography bearing the Joël Falmet house mark.
fields.name: Joël Falmet Éclat Blanc

fields.delivery_instructions: Leave with the concierge if no one answers.

fields.notes: Cancelled at the customer's request before dispatch.
Refunded after a damaged bottle was reported on arrival.

author: amelie.dubois
fields.comment: Excellent vintage, fast shipping from the cellar.
